build_transformer: build a Transformer model with configurable encoder and decoder layers for 3D voxel detection
create_transformer_encoder: create a TransformerEncoder with cloned encoder layers and optional layer normalization
create_transformer_decoder: create a TransformerDecoder with self-attention and cross-attention layers for object queries
run_transformer_forward: run the Transformer forward pass with source features, mask, query embeddings, and positional embeddings
create_encoder_decoder_layer: create a TransformerEncoderLayer or TransformerDecoderLayer with multihead attention and feedforward networks
